# 💡 Improvement Suggestion

Think an existing feature could be even better? We're listening! 🚀

This template is for **improving something that already exists**.

For entirely new functionality, please use the Feature Request template.

## Feature or Component

<!-- Which existing feature, tool, or component would you like to improve? -->

## Current Behavior

<!-- How does it currently work? -->

## Problem or Limitation

<!-- What makes the current behavior difficult, inefficient, or inconvenient? -->

## Proposed Improvement

<!-- Describe how you would like it to work instead. -->

## Expected Benefits

<!-- How would the proposed change improve the experience? -->

## Alternatives Considered (Optional)

<!-- Other possible approaches or existing workarounds. -->

## Examples or References (Optional)

<!-- Screenshots, mockups, links, or examples from other applications. -->

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] I could implement the improvement.
- [ ] I could help test the changes.
- [ ] I'm suggesting the improvement only.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for existing suggestions.
- [ ] The functionality already exists.
- [ ] I explained the current limitation and proposed improvement.

---

Thanks for helping us make things better! 💖
